subject: Direction requested on deteriorated existing structure behind the finish wall near Lobby

messages.text: We found the deteriorated existing structure behind the finish wall near Lobby 101 and need your sign-off before we commit to a permanent fix. This is becoming a priority as work proceeds nearby. A response next week would still let us stay on track.
Your proposed workaround at Lobby 101 is close, but we'd want it field-verified against General Conditions Article 3 before sign-off.
Following up on the workaround at Lobby 101 -- can we get a decision so the crew isn't idle much longer?
